summary: Analyse legal matter, spend and records data with EDRM and Excel methods. Explore the 5-day course and strengthen your legal operations reporting.
lede: Legal data analysis and information management training shows how to turn matter, billing and document records into usable operational evidence. For legal operations analysts, records managers, e-discovery specialists and in-house counsel, it covers checking data quality and records controls, analysing spend and workload in Excel, and tracking EDRM activity. Learners practise presenting traceable findings with appropriate confidentiality and data caveats.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for legal professionals who work with matter records, legal documents, billing data or records controls and need to turn that information into reliable operational analysis.
prerequisites: Prior experience working with legal matters, legal records, billing information or e-discovery workflows is recommended. Basic spreadsheet skills, including sorting, filtering and using formulas in Excel, will support the practical exercises. Coding or programming is not required.
